known.title: Standard: The error says what to do next

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Functional. After a snapshot loads, `fail()` hides the recovery message and displays only “Offline”. Stopping or restarting the board therefore leaves users with stale content and no next action; restarting creates a different address and token, so this page cannot recover by polling. The standard requires “The error says what to do next.” Keep the snapshot visible while also showing the recovery instructions.
